---
title: "filtering"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(animovement)

path_sleap_single <- testthat::test_path("data", "sleap", "SLEAP_single-mouse_EPM.analysis.h5")
df_sleap_single <- read_sleap(path_sleap_single)

deg <- 6  # degree
m <- 7    # kernel halfwidth
# Check parameters for your data
df_sleap_single |> 
  filter(keypoint == "centre") |> 
  pull(x) |> 
  get_ms_params() |> 
  str()

df_sleap_single |> 
  # filter(time %in% 1000:2000) |> 
  group_by(keypoint) |> 
  mutate(x1 = filter_ms(x, auto_params = FALSE, deg, m),
         y1 = filter_ms(y, auto_params = FALSE, deg, m),
         x2 = filter_ms(x, auto_params = FALSE, deg, m*2),
         y2 = filter_ms(y, auto_params = FALSE, deg, m),
         x3 = filter_ms(x),
         y3 = filter_ms(y),
         x4 = replace_na_stine(x3),
         y4 = replace_na_stine(y3),
         x4 = filter_ms(x4),
         y4 = filter_ms(y4)
         ) |> 
  filter(keypoint == "left_ear") |> 
  ggplot(aes(time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = x), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = x1), colour = "red") +
  geom_line(aes(y = x2), colour = "blue") +
  geom_line(aes(y = x4), colour = "purple") +
  labs(title = "Adaptive MS Filter for Tracking Data")

```
